tools.name: get_testers
tools.description: START HERE. One call gets an Android app its 12 Google Play closed-testing testers: adds the app if needed, opens its test, applies spare credits, and returns progress plus the few steps only a human can do (add our Google Group in Play Console; pay with one of the returned links, or test other apps

tools.name: about
tools.description: What Tester Exchange is, how credits work, and every available action.

tools.name: platform_stats
tools.description: Live platform numbers: members, apps testing, open tester slots, verified tester-days.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: How credits are earned and spent, and credit pack prices.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: The user's credit balance, invite link and open tests. (needs a token)

tools.name: my_apps
tools.description: The user's apps and the live status of each testing campaign (active testers, waiting installs, open slots). (needs a token)

tools.name: add_app
tools.description: List an Android app that is in Google Play closed testing (get_testers does this for you). The closed track must be published. (needs a token)

tools.name: start_campaign
tools.description: Start recruiting a set number of testers for one of the user's apps. Costs testers × 15 credits, held in escrow; unused credits go back to the user's balance (credits, not money). (needs a token)

tools.name: campaign_report
tools.description: Testers, daily active testers, feedback and the data needed to answer Play Console's production-access questions. (needs a token)

tools.name: add_testers
tools.description: Add tester slots to a live campaign (15 credits each). (needs a token)

tools.name: set_campaign_status
tools.description: Pause, resume or close a campaign. Closing returns unused credits to the user's balance. (needs a token)

tools.name: my_tests
tools.description: Tests the user is doing as a tester, with verified days and credits earned. (needs a token)

tools.name: share_kit
tools.description: Public "help test my app" page, a ready message and a README badge for one of the user's apps. (needs a token)

tools.name: buy_credits_links
tools.description: Checkout links for credit packs. A human must complete the payment. (needs a token)

tools.name: friends_status
tools.description: Who fills the 12 seats of one of the user's apps (friends, swap circle, exchange testers), how many seats are left, what the exchange would cost for them, and the share link. (needs a token)

tools.name: start_friends_test
tools.description: Free: open a test for one of the user's apps so friends and family can join from the share link. Returns the link and a ready message. They open the app once a day from testerexchange.com/earn. (needs a token)

tools.name: fill_from_exchange
tools.description: Pay credits only for the seats friends and the circle don't fill (15 credits per seat); exchange testers then join. (needs a token)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_friends_test · Private data: get_testers, my_account, my_apps, add_app, start_campaign, campaign_report, add_testers, set_campaign_status, my_tests, share_kit, buy_credits_links, friends_status, start_friends_test, fill_from_exchange · Public sink: share_kit, friends_status, start_friends_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_friends_test · Private data: get_testers, my_account, my_apps, add_app, start_campaign, campaign_report, add_testers, set_campaign_status, my_tests, share_kit, buy_credits_links, friends_status, start_friends_test, fill_from_exchange · Public sink: share_kit, friends_status, start_friends_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
